references.title: DWDS: Römer
references.supports: No Wortzerlegung for der Römer, 'bauchiges Trinkgefäß … schweres, geschliffenes Weinglas'; the Etymologie suggests, with an alternative, a borrowing (Lower Rhine, early 16th c.) from Dutch roemer, neither being a German Rom + -er formation

notes.rationale: The wine glass, der Römer. DWDS gives this homograph no Wortzerlegung, and its Etymologie, which hedges, takes it as a loan from Dutch roemer or from vitrum Romarium, neither a German Rom + -er formation, so it is a bottom word: the Root römer and the zero ending (ADR 0051). Someone from Rome splits Rom + -er (ADR 0050: the Reading owns the split).
